modules.module_title: Receive, store and maintain records of raw materials

pcs.pc_description: list the types of yarn and colour shades practiced in the respective cluster for yarn processing activities
implement steps to receive the materials from the dye master (yarn, chemicals, auxiliaries, recipe, delivery date, etc.), segregate and label for quick identification while processing the yarn
weigh the received materials (yarn, chemicals, auxiliaries, recipe, etc.) and record as per SOP
obtain required tools, equipment and machines at the workspace
record the details of the process to be carried on the yarn such as pre dyeing treatments, dyeing or finishing or combination thereof as per requirement
follow the supervisor’s instruction and correlate the yarn with the recipe for the process based on parameters such as yarn type, quantity etc.

modules.module_title: Prepare ation of material for yarn processing

pcs.pc_description: organize the received materials (yarn, chemicals, auxiliaries) for processing
calculate the quantity of materials required for sample and bulk processing (Material : Liquor ratio, chemicals, auxiliaries, etc.) for the received quantity of yarn in reference to given recipe
use prescribed and proper safety gear for the yarn processing operation
clean the dye bath as per standard procedure
maintain the prescribed processing conditions (temperature, pH level, etc.) and load the material into the dye bath

modules.module_title: Carry out the yarn processing and drying

pcs.pc_description: use prescribed quality of water for yarn processing
carry out sample/bulk processing activity(pre dyeing/ dyeing/finishing) for the received material as per recipe process specified
squeeze the processed yarn as per standard method using appropriate tools
prepare the drying area to dry the processed yarn (drying rod arrangement, drying height level, etc.)
arrange the processed yarn hanks in the drying area as per Standard procedure
rotate hanks at regular intervals in the drying area using appropriate tools and standard procedure
clean the work area and vessels after yarn processing as per standard protocol

modules.module_title: Get Approval and carry out bundling of processed yarn

pcs.pc_description: submit the processed sample to dye master for shade/ quality approval as per SOP
transfer yarn from drying area to bundling area using prescribed tools
bundle and tag the approved processed yarn as per work order specification
store the bundled yarn as per in the storage area by following standard guidelines
